channel.title: Dietary Insight Blog
channel.description: Practical, evidence-based guides on eating well with diabetes, high blood pressure and food allergies, from the team behind the Dietary Insight app.

item.title: Best Snacks for Type 2 Diabetes: Easy UK Ideas and Swaps
item.description: The best snacks for type 2 diabetes are fruit, veg, plain yoghurt and unsalted nuts. See calorie and carb counts plus simple swaps for crisps and sweets.

item.title: 12 Diabetes-Friendly Breakfast Ideas (UK Guide)
item.description: Simple breakfasts for type 2 diabetes built on fibre, protein and wholegrains, plus the cereal and juice traps to avoid. Quick UK ideas inside.

item.title: How Much Salt a Day? A UK Guide for High Blood Pressure
item.description: Adults should have no more than 6g of salt a day. Here's where it hides, how to read salt on labels and easy swaps to cut back.

item.title: How to Read UK Food Labels When You Have Diabetes
item.description: A simple guide to UK traffic-light labels, hidden sugar names and per-100g figures, so you can choose better food in the supermarket in seconds.

item.title: What Is Prediabetes and Can It Be Reversed? A UK Guide
item.description: Prediabetes means blood sugar is above normal but below type 2 diabetes. Learn the HbA1c numbers, who is at risk and the changes that can help.
